description: This Scala source file defines the ApplyDefaultCollation rule for Apache Spark SQL Catalyst optimizer. It handles resolution and application of default string/char/varchar collations in logical plans, especially for DDL commands like CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, and ALTER TABLE, ensuring proper inheritance of collation settings from schema, catalog, or explicit definitions.
